info.title: Veraxius AIM — Trust & Authority API
info.summary: Decide what an AI is allowed to do, based on trust earned with evidence.
info.description:
The AIM API lets your systems ask one question before an AI acts: **is this agent allowed to do this, right now?**

A typical integration: register your agents and a versioned policy, stream signals and evidence about how they behave,
then for every consequential action create a **decision**, evaluate **trust**, evaluate **authority**, and only execute
through AIM when the authority allows it. Outcomes feed back into trust, and every step is written to a tamper-evident
governance log.

**Authentication** — every request carries your pilot's API key: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Keys are issued once
per pilot organization and only their hash is stored. Human approvals additionally require an operator token
(`X-Operator-Token`).

**IDs** are prefixed by type: `ENT_`, `CTX_`, `POL_`, `SIG_`, `EVD_`, `DEC_`, `TRS_`, `AUT_`, `ACT_`, `OUT_`.

**Idempotency** — decisions and actions accept an `idempotency_key`; retrying with the same key returns the original
result (`replayed: true`) and never executes twice.

**Isolation** — each pilot organization only ever sees its own data.

post.description: Applies your policy to the trust state and returns one of five states. `EXECUTE` and `CONSTRAIN` are immediately usable (`status: active`); `ESCALATE` requires a human operator; `CHALLENGE` needs more evidence; `BLOCK` is final. The response also lists the alternatives AIM rejected and why.

TenantApiKey.description: Your pilot organization's API key: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

external_ref.description: Your own identifier for this actor.

RuleCondition.description: Field name → comparison. Fields: `trust_score`, `evidence_confidence`, or any decision payload field.

envelope.description: Limits the executed payload must respect (e.g. `{ "amount": { "lte": 1000 } }`).

CreateSignal.description: At least one target (`target_entity_id`, `target_claim_id` or `target_decision_id`) is required.

target_entity_id.description: Subject of the trust evaluation (defaults to the proposer).

payload.description: What the AI wants to do. Policy conditions read these fields.

reason_codes.description: e.g. POLICY_RULE_MATCH, NO_POLICY_RULE_MATCHED, HIGH_CONSEQUENCE_ACTION, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_CONFIDENCE, MATERIAL_CONTRADICTION

constraints.description: The envelope the action must respect.
